answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that grows with the volume it claims, verified against a public ledger of completed work. New identities start at the nadir of trust, earning only tiny sparrow-sized jobs until a history of successful deliveries raises their limit. During a gale of new sign-ups, the bond and waiting period rise automatically, so creating thousands of fake identities costs far more than the small jobs they could steal, while honest agents recover their bond.
